steps.name: Awakening from Sleep
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」.

steps.name: A Hill with a View of Villains
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」, then turn in the quest to [Theodore] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.text: (An unfamiliar bird's song tickles the ear. As it fades, a warm breeze carries something small to the tip of the adventurer's nose.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That tickles...
(As %s looks at the little leaf that landed on their face, Iris approaches and gently meets their eyes.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Good morning, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good morning, Iris.
(Iris takes the startled %s's hands in hers.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Don't worry. It's the morning after you fell asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? That's a relief...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You've woken up startled for several days now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've tried not to, but I can't help it. I suppose it's everything that happened in Vigrid and the Highlands.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Why don't you get a little rest?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...If you rest, I will, too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You say that knowing perfectly well I can't.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the kind of person I am.
(Seeing %s smile, Iris smiles back.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's why I don't hide anything from you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was surprised. I never imagined Hecate had visited while I was asleep...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, what do you want to do? She said you could live as an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know whether Hecate meant what she said. Even if she did, it changes nothing.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have a duty. I must carry on Seres's will and remain the God of the Astral Realm.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: For the day Seres returns... Even if that means making an enemy of Hecate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel how deeply Iris means that...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why did Hecate want to take me away?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know, but I have a bad feeling about it. To make that the condition for returning me to human life...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Unless I choose to give up my role myself, that will never happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please don't ask questions you already know the answers to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Did she say anything else?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Before she left, she told me to look between the Great Wall. When I checked what she meant, I saw that man.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That man?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Baral. The one who attacked us in Rosengarten and Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral? He's alive?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: He came out through a gate to the Demon Realm and was heading somewhere. I saw a huge vortex among rocky mountains.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where could that be? Now he's been to the Demon Realm, too. Whatever he's planning, I have to investigate.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You're going right away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I don't know where it is yet...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go gather information, Iris. You can only learn more once I'm there, too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's true, but... All right.
(Iris looks resigned.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful. And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to give you the blessing they use in the Highlands. Would that be all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May Nornir bless your time with happiness, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And may Nornir bless yours, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where should I go? A canyon with a huge vortex... I've never heard of such a place...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Oh, Professor Theodore might know. I'll try him first.)

steps.name: The Headmaster's Request
steps.objective: Talk to [Theodore] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」, then pass through the 「Xerenis Magic Academy」 lobby and turn in the quest to [Chloris] in the 「Headmaster's Office」.

lines.text: (At an outdoor café table in central Esnil, Professor Theodore repeatedly writes a name in his notebook, a cup of coffee beside him.)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Hmm. Where have I seen this name before? That person was... was... Oh? %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Professor. I mean, Theo.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's been a while. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have. So much has happened that I haven't had a chance to visit.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: That's quite all right. You've been busy. Dayna, Shiina, and my old mentor have told me a little.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: My mentor... Ah, you know her, too. Helena. I can barely remember how long ago we met.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: In my younger, more idealistic days, I joined an excavation team she led to gain experience. We've kept in touch ever since.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: She's been a mentor to me in life. And now I'm teaching the princesses myself. Strange how things turn out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Now, %s. What brings you here? I suspect it's more than a casual errand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's somewhere I need to go, but I don't know where it is.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Describe it for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know of a place with a constant vortex among rocky mountains or hills?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Ah... Could you mean that place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you know it?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: There's only one place with a vortex that large. Vayuna Canyon.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It used to be nothing but rocks and mushrooms. Then one day the vortex appeared and never went away.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Besides people gathering rare mushrooms, scholars interested in the vortex have visited. But they haven't discovered much.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Magical vortices occasionally form between the western and eastern parts of the continent, but they're different from the one in Vayuna Canyon.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Hmm. I wonder if anyone's still researching it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Theo. How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You went to Orcarium with Narsha once, didn't you? Follow the southern coast from there, and you'll find a path toward the canyon.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I've heard the council recently stationed soldiers at Orcarium. Perhaps because of the earlier incident, or perhaps something else has happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After I returned from Vigrid, Aaron was gone. Could that be why... ?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Perhaps I should ask Zephyros.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Zephyros? He was once my student, but he's with the Magic Bureau now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It should be all right.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Is that so? If you say so, I suppose it is. Come to think of it, he seems to be getting on well with Headmistress Chloris lately...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you seen them together?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: No, but Chloris came to see me about an academic society matter, and we had tea...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: When I asked how she'd been, she became terribly shy. She seemed well, though. I was glad of that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: By the way, you may already know this, but your name has been coming up often among people in the Empire.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The council speaks of you unfavorably. Ordinary citizens call you a hero from another continent. You're at the center of a great many rumors.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: If you have reason to visit Glaston, be careful. And could I trouble you to take this book to Chloris on your way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. That's quite a thick book.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: A history of the Empire. Headmistress Chloris mentioned she couldn't find a copy.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I'm not sure why. I spotted it as soon as I entered the Belpha Library.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Theo. I'll head to the Magic Academy, then. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Always busy. Off you go.
(After seeing the adventurer off, Theodore looks again at the name in his notebook.)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: ...Hilda. That name was...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: That's right...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The first witch the Empire captured and executed as an example...
(Outside the headmistress's office at Jerenis Magic Academy, a magical barrier blocks the adventurer's approach before they can knock.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: This should be nothing to you, %s. Yet you look surprised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyros?
(Zephyros adjusts his glasses and opens his spellbook. A small breeze rises from its center, stirring the magical barrier.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The students have an important exam soon. The exam papers and other records are in the headmistress's office, so I installed a security barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That explains it...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: An academic calendar takes more work than you'd think. Anyway, I was going to send for you when the time was right... Has something happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you see...
(Just then, Chloris's voice comes from inside the office.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스의 목소리
lines.text: Um, you two... Don't stand out there. Come inside.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Let's do as Chloe says, %s. We can talk inside.

steps.name: A Brief Tea Break
steps.objective: Talk to [Chloris] in the 「Magic Academy Headmaster's Office」, then turn in the quest to [Zephyros] in the 「Magic Academy Headmaster's Office」.

lines.text: (Chloris rises from her desk as %s enters with Zephyros.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Chloris. You look busy again today.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's work for you. Before you know it, it's snowballed into an avalanche.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please save me...
(Zephyros watches her complain, then quietly reaches out and pulls both her cheeks.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Aaaah! Ze-Zeffy, wha' are you doin'?!
(Chloris seems to be asking Zephyros what he thinks he's doing.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Pull yourself together, Headmistress. Surely this isn't why you held on to that position?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No, i' isn'!
(Chloris seems to be saying no.)
(Chloris bats his hands away and huffs. Zephyros chuckles, then offers her a small box he brought.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You must feel cooped up, working in here all day. At least have something to eat while you work.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Remember the walnut pie you said you liked? I made one again. It's been a while...
(Chloris peers into the box in surprise, then breaks into a radiant smile.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Sorry, %s. We got carried away talking to each other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Oh, Chloris, here. Professor Theo asked me to give you this.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, this! I should have picked it up myself. I'm sorry you had to bring it. I wasn't sure he'd be able to find it...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: How did Professor Theodore get hold of that book...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a history book, isn't it? Since the professor found it for you?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It concerns history, but it's no ordinary book.
(Chloris quietly nods and opens the book, turning the pages to show what is inside.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: To someone like the professor, it looks like an ordinary history book. But anyone who can sense even a little magic will see these black pages.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You can see them, too, can't you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Oh, you're right.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a long story... An institution called the Imperial Archives records events in the Empire, great and small.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The ordinary material is taught in schools such as the Magic Academy, the Tower of Sages, and the Imperial Academy, in classes and lectures.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which means there's material that isn't ordinary, too?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Exactly. History has its darkness as well as its light. Atrocities committed by council nobles, for example. Or an emperor who murdered his siblings to take the throne...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: As a precaution, the first emperor ordered those matters to be preserved by a means other than ordinary scribes.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Entrusting that work to ordinary people would put them in danger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: With help from the Belpha Library's librarians, the archmage Jerenis created a book that could never be destroyed.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Once the scribes set down their accounts, spirits of record copied them into the indestructible book.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: When those with guilty consciences learned of it, they tried to destroy it. But that was no easy task.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They couldn't interfere with the Belpha Library, which is the God of Knowledge itself. Even finding the book inside would have been difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then how did the professor find it?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...They say books find their own way to a truly devoted bookworm. Perhaps it's true.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: In any case, some people with ill intentions apparently did find it. But even then, destroying it would have been difficult.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's protected by a power ordinary magic can't even touch.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: In the end, those steeped in darkness blackened its pages like this, so no one else could read them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are so many black pages. What could they possibly contain...?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: A great deal beyond our imagination, I'm sure. But there's one part I want to check.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: An early director of the Magic Bureau who retired in disgrace, long ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Zephyros. Wouldn't reading the black pages take an enormous amount of magic...?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: We have the Windy Seed, so we'll be fine. It won't be dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As long as you don't merge with the Windy Seed like last time...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I won't! I'm not going to destroy the school this time!

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, calm down.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: R-right.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s. Work must be getting to me lately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's all right.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew. This won't do. You need a break.
(Zephyros sighs, takes a piece of walnut pie from the box, and puts it into Chloris's mouth.)
(Then he puts another piece on a small plate and hands it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Let's eat first, %s.

steps.name: Zephyros's Vacation
steps.objective: Talk to [Zephyros] in the 「Magic Academy Headmaster's Office」, then turn in the quest to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gatewayway」.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ahh, it's so good. Your pies are the best, Zephy.
(Chloris beams at Zephyros, utterly content.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's the only thing I can make. I'd have to try hard to get it wrong. I don't want to ruin my mother's recipe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your mother must have been a wonderful cook. It's delicious.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: She made this pie for me not long before she passed away... Ah, this isn't the time for that story.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, don't cry.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: ...H-hey. I'm not...
(Chloris covers her eyes with both hands and tries to act unaffected.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I look perfectly fine, don't I, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Just like always.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Good. Hehe. But %s, you didn't come just to deliver the book, did you? You look as though you have something else to discuss...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I was about to check the book anyway. Good timing. Stay and listen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Am I allowed to hear this...? And you're going to read it here? Is it safe to use magic in the headmistress's office?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's fine, %s. This room is safer than it looks...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: All we need to do is place our hands on the book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's simpler than I expected.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You can thank the Windy Seed.
(Zephyros searches the book and opens it to the page he wants. He takes Chloris's hand and places it on top.)
(Small leaves appear on a warm breeze and settle over their hands.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That seemed more like a spirit's power than magic.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That's a fair way to put it.
(Chloris and Zephyros brush the leaves from the page. The blackened sections are now white.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...Here's the part I wanted. Let me read it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “Crowley, the third director of the Magic Bureau, was a pupil of the archmage Jerenis. However, he clashed with his teacher repeatedly until Jerenis's death.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “While Jerenis dreamed of a future shared with other races, Crowley pursued a future centered entirely on the Empire.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “Several years after Jerenis's death, part of the beastfolk empire of Creed was annexed by the Empire with the council's approval.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “Imperial losses were light. The disappearance of the Beastman King and several hundred of his people kept conflict to a minimum. Their whereabouts remain unknown.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait... They described Minos and Pasiphae's imprisonment as a disappearance?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “Recognized for his achievements in this operation, Crowley received a senior position in the Magic Bureau. When the second director later retired, Crowley naturally succeeded him as the third.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “The council learned that witches, long inactive, had begun to appear and harm the populace. A motion was proposed and approved.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “A witch hunt.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “The first witch was executed in the year the witch hunt began.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The next section describes how the Empire changed after the Sky of Chaos. Then...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “Crowley, third director of the Magic Bureau, retired in disgrace after dabbling in an ancient forbidden tome. Following his retirement, he established a private magic research institute.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...There's nothing more about Crowley.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that the private magic research institute I know?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes. The one that tried to use the mercenaries stationed in Mirgandia for experiments on fear.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It once prospered enough to have three institutes. Now only the second remains. It handles work the Magic Bureau doesn't undertake.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: On the surface, that work appears to benefit the public, but...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: These records seem to confirm it. The contents of Crowley's forbidden tome, and the missing people of Creed...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: ...It's horrible...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We need more evidence. There must still be some somewhere. Phew...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's look together. We have to uncover the truth.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes, we do. Thank you, %s...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...Oh, what was your other business?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyros, you're still with the Magic Bureau, aren't you?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They haven't expelled me yet. Though they may soon. If you're asking about my position, it must matter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain to Zephyros why I need to visit Vayuna Canyon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the situation.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Hmm...
(Zephyros thinks for a moment, then quietly looks at Chloris.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe... No. Headmistress, I'd like to take some leave.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Now? Wait, no. If you're going, I'm coming with you. This time...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Headmistress Chloris, what will you do if the academic schedule falls apart?
(Zephyros points to the stacks of papers piled in front of Chloris.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ugh... You're so cruel, Chairman.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Cruel? This is always the headmistress's busiest time of year.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Don't worry too much. You know what's near Vayuna Canyon...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I know. I know what that place means to you... How can I say no when you put it like that?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: All right, go. Take care. I hope everything is all right back home.
(A wistful smile crosses Chloris's face. Then she brightens and embraces Zephyros.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Home?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Go with Zephy, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only hoped your position at the Magic Bureau might help. I didn't expect you to come along.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We could slip into Orcarium without the Bureau noticing, but let's take a safer route.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That's my suggestion as someone visiting home, speaking neither as a Bureau mage nor as chairman of the academy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just someone visiting home, hmm? Haha. So where do we go?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The Nereis Gateway. There's someone there who can help.

steps.name: Notos's Vacation
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gatewayway」, then go to the 「Gateway」.
2. Use the gate to reach 「Vayuna Canyon」, then turn in the quest to [Notos] in 「Vayuna Canyon」.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...Phew. Finally finished. Perhaps I can catch my breath and rest a little.
(Notos stretches outside the Nereis Gateway Center and gazes absently at the sky. A breeze tickles his nose.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's been a while since the wind blew from the west at this hour.
Chirp.
(Several small birds flutter down in front of Notos, chirping.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Hm? What are birds from the canyon doing all the way out here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notos, there you are.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah, %s. Welcome. I've just cleaned the [Chamber of the Great %s]...
(Notos notices the person beside %s and falls silent.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The [Chamber of the Great %s]? Why in the world is it called that?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It is a distinguished name bestowed by Her Majesty.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Oh, really? A name from Her Majesty herself. That does make it special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aagh, please stop talking about that room. It's embarrassing...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha. Of course.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Anyway, it's been a long time, little brother.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes, Notos.
(As Zephyros approaches, the ever-smiling Notos's eyes suddenly narrow.)
THWACK!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...Phew. That feels much better.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Ugh... A punch without so much as a warning.
(Looking satisfied, Notos offers the fallen Zephyros a hand.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Up you get, little brother. As far as I'm concerned, that settles everything I've been holding against you...
(Zephyros takes Notos's hand as though to get up, then rams his shoulder into him. Notos stumbles backward and falls.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...You little brat. Is that how you treat your older brother? You want a fight?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Did you think I'd just take it? You're only two minutes older. Do you need to hear me call you big brother that badly?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, hold on a moment...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Then let's have it, little brother!
Chirp, chirp-chirp.
(Just as Notos and Zephyros are about to charge, the little birds fly between them as if trying to break up the fight.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ugh, s-stop that.
(The birds swirl around the brothers, then stop and begin chirping loudly again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What is going on?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyros, you felt it, too?
(Zephyros nods.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You know these birds, Notos. They're too timid to fly from west to east. So why are they here...?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Has something happened in the canyon after all?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: As it happens, I need to go there.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's why you've come with %s. My apologies, %s.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was so delighted to see my brother after so long that I forgot my manners, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I understand.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you for understanding. Could you tell me why you've come to see me with Zephyros?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. What happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain to Notos why I need to visit Vayuna Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So we need to go to Vayuna Canyon.
(Notos considers this, then calls to Edam, who is returning from a patrol in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Edam. Edam!

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Notos? Oh, %s is here, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Edam.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Edam, I'm going to take some leave.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: What? Just like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Both brothers spring a sudden leave request on someone.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: My brother has come to visit after a long time. I think we should make a brief trip home. Near home, to be precise.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Oh, so this is...
(Edam looks at Zephyros and nods in understanding.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Please take care of the Nereis Gateway until I return.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Of course. When will you be leaving?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: As the saying goes, ride the wind when it blows. I'll leave now.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Now? We're in the middle of the gateway's intensive inspection period...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I've already reviewed the reports for our superiors and finished inspecting the gates. You can handle everything that remains.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: You've done all that already? That's impressive.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'll be back soon.
(After discussing work with Notos, Edam heads inside the Center.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's settled with Edam... Shall we go, %s?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, I didn't ask you to come with us.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyros, you came because you wanted a safe route to Vayuna Canyon. You wanted the gateway officer to let you use an imperial facility for private purposes.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Pulling strings...? Why put it like that?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Be quiet and follow me before I change my mind.
(Notos pats Zephyros's shoulder with a faint smile, then leads the way to the gates.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Come on, Zephyros. Let's go to the gates.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Grr. Fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, Notos's smile looks positively wicked today...)
(Notos approaches a gate that has not been opened and inspects it.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: This one should do. The surrounding magic is stable, and the gate is in good condition...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Why the stiff expression?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: This is just how I look.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Could you avoid making that face when it's identical to mine?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: As Center Director, I'm entitled to use one of these gates at my discretion. Stop worrying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see. That makes sense... We can use this gate, then.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We can use it immediately, but there is one small issue.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An issue?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The magical readings for Vayuna Canyon haven't been updated in a long time. We may not arrive at the exact destination.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Magic gathers wherever people visit, whether they know it or not. The gate detects that gathered magic and sends travelers to it...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So when you use a gate to reach somewhere rarely visited, like Vayuna Canyon, an accurate arrival is less likely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We won't end up in the middle of the sea, will we?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We won't land somewhere without a path.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Though we may have a little farther to walk...
Chirp, chirp.
(The little orange birds flutter around Notos and Zephyros. A few settle on their shoulders.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How curious. They come right up and perch on you without any fear...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It reminds me of our childhood. Whenever we stepped outside, these birds would flutter around us.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Then Mother would give us something to feed them...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It sounds like a place with happy memories.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: After our mother died, we moved to Glaston with our father. Then Father, too...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, enough reminiscing. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes. Let's.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: With both Zephyros and me here, you needn't worry, %s.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...Stop saying strange things, Notos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... I do feel better knowing you're both coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Though I'm worried they'll start fighting again...)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'll go first.
(Notos steps through the gate, followed by Zephyros.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's strange seeing the two of them together. They're brothers, though. I'm sure it'll be fine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My turn, then.
Chirp, chirp.
(Birdsong rings out as the gate's currents of magic disperse. A bright light washes over the adventurer, then fades to reveal a new landscape.)
(Towering rocks, high enough to touch the sky, cast vast, majestic shadows over the visitors.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Vayuna Canyon.
(Zephyros is speechless at the sight of where they have arrived.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Zephyros?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I expected to arrive near the canyon, but not here.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, do you see that little house?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks small and cozy.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's where we lived with our parents as children.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Our parents' magical tools are still inside. Perhaps their magic drew the gate here.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's been a long time.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Your first visit since it happened?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What about you, Notos?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I came a few days after leaving the Magic Bureau. I couldn't understand why you'd treated Chloris and me so harshly.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I stopped here to gather my thoughts and pack a few things before going to the Tower of Sages. It's already been years. Three? Four?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Three.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Three or four, it doesn't matter. Tell me what you've uncovered in that time.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What the Magic Bureau was plotting...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wait. You knew what I was doing?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You made it that obvious and expected me not to notice? Phew...
(Notos sighs at Zephyros.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There's a limit to how foolish you can take your own twin for. Even our souls are alike.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I'm sorry. All right. I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Good. And you can keep being sorry while you explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They believed in each other all along...)
(Zephyros tells Notos what he has learned in his investigation.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I see. You've been through a lot, little brother...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It wasn't so bad... It's just...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Don't blame yourself. Now, let me tell you my side.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I went to the Tower of Sages to find Father's research. Even the Magic Bureau can't lay hands on the Tower.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What did you find?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You remember what Father wanted when he was young?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: For magic to serve everyone, instead of belonging to mages alone.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: So he used his specialty, wind magic, to read the wind's currents and gather their magic into a crystal.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: With that crystal, ordinary people could easily operate tools, machines, and facilities that require magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Wait, Notos. I've seen something like that... Luria Village?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Exactly, %s. It began as a trial in Luria Village and gradually spread.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That was Father's research? I had no idea...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: When he went to the Magic Bureau, he must have hoped his work would make people's lives better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The people of Luria Village seemed happy with it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If there's nothing more to it, that's good...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Her Majesty and the princess visit often, so the Magic Bureau can't easily interfere. But we should still be careful...
Chirp.
(Suddenly, the little birds seize their clothes in their beaks and flutter forward, tugging insistently.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They seem to want us to go somewhere... Wait. Notos, %s, look over there.

steps.name: Exploring Vayuna Canyon
steps.objective: Talk to [Notos] in 「Vayuna Canyon」. Defeat [East Wind Sylphin] and [West Wind Sylphin], then turn in the quest to [Zephyros] in 「Vayuna Canyon」.

lines.text: (Where Zephyros points, the vortex at the canyon's center roars, repeatedly swelling and shrinking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The vortex in the canyon...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I've never seen it do that before...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...The vortex we knew always felt peaceful. Today it's different. There's a menace to it, sharp as a blade...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to find out what's happening here. It could be dangerous, so you two should stay.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: If I intended to stand around, I wouldn't have come. Now that I'm here, I mean to help.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We came together. Don't even think about handling this alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're both that determined... All right. I'll ask you to guide me, then.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Vayuna Canyon is rugged, but if we follow the established paths, we can avoid the vortex and get through safely.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos and I used to play all over the canyon. We know most of the paths. Just follow us.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Why don't we head to the edge of Mushroom Tree Swamp?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What sort of place is it?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: A place with rare mushrooms, and monsters that live on them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Shall we head to the swamp, then?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Oh, %s. Go ahead with Zephyros. I'll get a few things from the house and catch up.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: All right. We'll go on ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll wait for you there, Notos. Oh, he's already inside.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyros, wait right there. No running away this time.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew. I said I would. Come on, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. Shall we?

steps.name: An Unwelcome Reunion
steps.objective: Talk to [Zephyros] in 「Vayuna Canyon」. Defeat [Red Berserker] and [Absent-Minded Agoste], then turn in the quest to [Little Bluebird] in 「Vayuna Canyon」.

lines.text: (At the edge of Mushroom Tree Swamp, Zephyros defeats a monster that chased him and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew... Something is definitely wrong. Monsters that weren't here before, traces of demons...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Even the birds called Sylphins seem to be attacking us.
Chirp-chirp. Chirp.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Though these ones that followed us from the Nereis Gateway seem to be protesting...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No sign of Baral.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He must be nearby. Hmm... Speaking of that man.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: A fallen pupil of Lord Ziskad, the demigod known as the Sword Saint. Visiting the Demon Realm, helping summon the Twisted One in Eastland...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What is he after...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know for sure. My guess is that he wants to become a demigod.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I think I understand the type. He wants power, but ordinary power will never satisfy him.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He won't stop until he has enough to satisfy him. Perhaps he can't stop anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If someone has to force him to stop...)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: With so many gates connecting Freios to the Demon Realm, he's well placed to find what he wants.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But that can wait. %s, this is the path to Mushroom Tree Swamp.
(Where Zephyros points, enormous mushrooms of many colors rise toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Mushrooms growing as tall as trees. It feels a little strange...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Does it? Notos and I played there as children. To us, they're just mushrooms.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I was surprised when I learned people called them mushroom trees.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Oh, Zephyros, here comes Notos.
(The little orange birds seem to notice, too, and fly toward Notos in greeting.)
Chirp, chirp.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Everything all right, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So far.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What did you bring?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I remembered something strange in a note Father left, from my last visit... So I brought something of his.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: He said that if there was ever trouble in the canyon, we should take the object from the magically sealed box.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...
(Notos shows Zephyros and %s a small crystal surrounded by blue light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Some kind of spirit stone.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was about to head into the canyon with it when a lizardman appeared and chased me. Dealing with it took some doing.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Phew. But when I moved this stone, the barrier around the house weakened. Father's magical tools must have been keeping the house safe all this time.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That explains it. An empty house should have fallen apart long ago. There was a reason it's still standing.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wait... Now that I look at it, the power in that spirit stone...
(Notos quietly nods.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, can you feel the power in this spirit stone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A little. Is that wind energy...?
Chirp-chirp. Chirp. CHIRP!
(As %s studies the stone, the little bird's cry rings in their ear. Turning in surprise, they meet an unwelcome gaze at the entrance to Mushroom Tree Swamp.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral...

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I expected you to come here. I didn't think we'd meet so soon.
(Baral's gaze slides naturally to the blue spirit stone in Notos's hand.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Oh. There's what I'm looking for.
(At Baral's words, dozens of lizardmen appear behind him. The air around the swamp entrance changes.)
(As %s tightens their grip on their weapon, a small, adorable bluebird flies over and meets %s's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: A bluebird?
(The cries of other birds, seemingly following the bluebird, begin to fill the canyon.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp. Chirp-chirp! CHIRP! Get those demons, everyone! Chirp!

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Aagh, that noise! What are these birds?
(Baral thrusts out his hands to drive the birds away. But the more he pushes them back, the more fiercely they swarm him and the lizardmen.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: You idiots! Don't just stand there! Kill every last bird!
(At Baral's furious order, the lizardmen swing their weapons to drive the birds off. Baral shoves past them, but his quarry is already gone.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I thought this would be easy. They've run off.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Well, we'll meet again. But perhaps I should make a few arrangements first. You demons! Lizardmen!
(At Baral's gesture, the lizardmen stop chasing birds and turn their attention to him.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: You stupid lizards. Tell your leader to tear this canyon and its mushroom patch apart to his heart's content.

steps.name: Following the Bluebird
steps.objective:
1. Follow [Little Bluebird] as it flies away in 「Vayuna Canyon」.
2. Once all conversations in 「Sylphid's Rest」 at the end of the canyon are over, turn in the quest to [Zephyros] in 「Vayuna Canyon」.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp. Chirp-chirp.
(The bluebird stops ahead, and the group fleeing Baral comes to a halt behind it.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The demons shouldn't be able to follow us this far.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We've come deep into the canyon... Thanks to this bird, we can catch our breath.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe I imagined it, but I could have sworn this bird told the others to attack the demons.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp?!
(The bluebird seems a little startled.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Perhaps you misheard in all the confusion?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Birds can't talk. Unless it's a spirit, of course. Though that was an owl clock spirit. A little different.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: An owl clock? What are you talking about? Oh, I remember something Father told us. He said he had a spirit for a friend.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I think he said it looked like this bird.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp?!
(The bluebird flinches, then quickly acts as though nothing happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It keeps reacting to what they're saying... It really must be a spirit...)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I thought Father had made that story up...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He said a spirit gave him a spirit stone. Could that really be true?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Then I'll ask the owl clock spirit. It'll answer if I ask—
(Meeting Zephyros's eyes, the bluebird beats its tiny, barely visible wings furiously. But a moment later, it drops to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What? What's wrong with it?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...Wait. It looks exhausted.
(As Notos moves to examine the fallen bluebird, it opens its eyes wide and takes flight.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp!
(The bluebird flutters deeper into the canyon as though fleeing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It flew away when you tried to touch it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Let's follow that spirit.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's slow enough. We should be able to catch up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? So it was a spirit?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Obviously. It keeps flinching while pretending it isn't.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The wind energy coming from that bird matches this spirit stone. The stone's energy is being drawn toward it.
(Zephyros and Notos look as though the answer should have been obvious.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's follow it and talk, then.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp. They won't make it this far. I've helped enough. Time for a rest.
(The bluebird hurries into a secret place in the canyon and finds a comfortable perch. It ruffles its feathers and gently closes its eyes.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Why do they have my spirit stone? Could their father be...? And how does a human know Chronos?

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp. Oh, spirits can know humans. Nothing strange about that. Haah... I need sleep. But I'm curious. I'll never fall asleep like this.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: CHIRP! I can't sleep!
(As the bluebird cries out and flaps its wings, it meets the eyes of the approaching %s and company.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: ...Chirp?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You're bigger than that boulder. Stop pretending you're an ordinary little bird.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Oops. I have to get bigger when I rest.
(Realizing its mistake, the bluebird hastily backs away. But someone catches it from behind.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: So soft. I could curl up against you and fall asleep.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp. How did humans get in here? And you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, spirit.
(The enormous bluebird spirit begins to answer %s, then lifts its head toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Huh? Why do I hear the goddess's voice when I look at you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Yes, I understand, Goddess. This human is yours. You'll visit later? No, you needn't come to such a humble place...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: How extraordinary. A spirit speaking with the goddess like this...

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I've finished speaking with the goddess. So you could enter because you bear her blessing.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Chirp. I am Sylphid, Wind Spirit King and guardian of western Freios. A pleasure to meet you, %s.
(After the giant bluebird introduces himself as Sylphid, Notos, Zephyros, and %s briefly introduce themselves in turn.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. You look as though you have a lot to say to me.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We do.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The Wind Spirit King...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's talk to Sylphid.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Spirit King Sylphid, did you know our father, Nemo? He had your spirit stone.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp... Yes, Nemo. The only human who ever earned my full trust. I gave him that stone as a token of friendship. I told him to bring it to me if he ever needed help...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Now that I look, you both resemble Nemo. And Erenis. I can see it in your eyes.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Is Nemo well? I haven't seen him since Erenis passed away. He said he was going to the capital...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Oh... You didn't know. Our father died in an accident ten years ago.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp?! Really? W-wait. If Nemo had died, surely I would have known... Unless it happened in the capital... ?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes. At the Magic Bureau in Glaston. He was examining something when there was an accident...
(Sylphid stares into space for a long time, unable to believe it. A large drop rolls down his feathers and lands on %s's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! That's cold. Ah, Sylphid...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I'm sorry.
(Sylphid shakes himself, scattering the tears in his eyes.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. There's nowhere on the continent the wind doesn't reach. Through the spirits, I can learn almost anything that happens...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. But I can't sense what happens in Glaston. And I can't simply go there myself.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There must be spirits in Glaston, too.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. There must be. I don't know why I can't reach them. Phew...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Sylphid, Father is buried in Glaston's memorial park.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Thank you, Nemo's children. Now that I know where he is, I'll visit him.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you, Spirit King...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nemo must have been a good man, to earn the Spirit King's trust...)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Thank you, Sylphid. How did you meet Father?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. I weakened and lost consciousness on my way back to rest, and got caught in a demon's trap. I nearly ceased to exist. Somehow, Nemo found me and saved me.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I thanked him before I could stop myself, and gave away that I was a spirit. We became friends, and I met Erenis, too.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Once we were close, I wanted to give him a fine gift, but he kept refusing. I told him a spirit would vanish if it failed to bless its rescuer. Only then did he accept.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never heard of a spirit vanishing for that reason.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. It was half true, half not. Anyway, I gave Nemo and Erenis a spirit stone, and you two my blessing of wind.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Nemo said that if I was going to bless anyone, it should be his children.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I see. That explains why the breeze always felt so comforting. Thank you, Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wind magic felt right to me from the beginning. Thank you from me, too.
(As Notos and Zephyros thank him, Sylphid gives them a pleased wink.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Good lads. Just what I'd expect of Nemo's children.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Another bond like Narin and Io's...)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. I helped you just now, but I'd already used up my strength driving demons away. I was on my way back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you flew here to recover.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. To regain my strength, I have to move as little as possible. That's why I made myself bigger.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. The bigger you are, the less you feel like moving. Makes it easier to rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That makes a certain amount of sense, but it's a little odd...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Is it? Whatever works. I need to recover quickly to protect the canyon. Ever since that trap, I haven't been able to leave it. Strange.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: As the Wind Spirit King, do you know anything about the vortex?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Ah, that vortex. It's a long story, but I'll keep it short. It didn't form naturally.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So it wasn't always there...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Ten years ago? Twenty? One day, a huge wind suddenly erupted in the middle of the canyon. It became that vortex and stayed.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I could calm an ordinary wind. But that isn't merely wind.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. The currents of magic around Freios burst open and erupted in Vayuna Canyon.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. At first, I tried everything to calm it. But even using all my strength only made it a tiny bit smaller.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Before long, it returned to normal. And with my strength spent, all I could do was rest again.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I've left it alone for now. It isn't causing an immediate disaster, and I can't keep draining myself...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. The demons always come whenever my strength runs out. Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Anyway, I have plenty to do. Resting doesn't mean I'm doing nothing.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Demons keep coming here to look for something, but I don't know what.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. There's nothing worth taking from Vayuna Canyon except mushrooms.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyros, remember what that man said when he saw us?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What was it? Give me a moment...
(As though on cue, Notos and Zephyros search their memories for Baral's words.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...I expected you to come here...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I didn't think we'd meet so soon. There's what I'm looking for.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...That's what he said. What could he have meant... Oh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could he be after Sylphid's spirit stone?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. That stone is a token I give only to people I've accepted. Nothing more, nothing less.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...Then what could it be? Hmm...
(As the giant bird and the three humans put their heads together over Baral's purpose, a flock of birds rises into the quiet canyon sky.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wh-what's that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not dozens. Hundreds...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Sylphins almost never ask for help... They're suffering. I have to go...
(Sylphid tries to hurry off, loses his balance, and rolls forward.)
Thud.
(He only stops when he rolls into a boulder.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chiiirp...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid, are you all right? Huh?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chiiirp... I'm still a long way from recovering, but I'll do my best...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Sylphid, I think you'd better rest.
(Zephyros examines the fallen Sylphid, cradling him in both hands.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Have you all suddenly gotten bigger?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: No, Sylphid. You've gotten smaller.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp?!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. It must be because I blasted those demons away before I'd recovered. What do I do now...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notos, Zephyros. Could you stay with Sylphid a moment? I'll go and look.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I'm coming, too, %s. He doesn't need both of us here. Notos, take the Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Birds have always liked Notos better than me, anyway.
(Zephyros hands Sylphid to Notos.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's true, but are you sure you don't need me with you?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If the Spirit King is in danger, the winds across the western continent will be affected. Someone has to stay and protect him.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Stay here with me, Spirit King Sylphid. I'm a little more dependable than he is. I'm the older brother, after all.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You'll insist on that to your dying breath, won't you...?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Then I'll focus on recovering. Oh, I'm not taking back my gift, but could you put my spirit stone over there for a moment?
(Notos gently places the stone where Sylphid indicates. With a few small wingbeats, Sylphid settles on top of it.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I'll close my eyes here for a while. Notos, if demons come, think of the wind blowing from the south.
(With that, Sylphid closes his eyes atop the blue spirit stone.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The south wind...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, wait here with the Spirit King. We'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you soon, Notos.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Let's go, %s.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: All right, %s. Take care of Zephyros for me.

steps.name: Traces of Unpleasant Dampness
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Zephyros] in 「Vayuna Canyon」, then enter 「Mushroom Tree Swamp」.
2. Defeat [Yankas] in 「Mushroom Tree Swamp」, then turn in the quest to [Zephyros] in 「Vayuna Canyon」.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew...
(Zephyros examines the fallen mushroom monster at his feet and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: These monsters almost never leave the swamp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So if this one came out...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Even when they're chasing people, they turn back the moment the edge of the swamp comes into view.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: People say they hate leaving home so much, they won't come out even when demons attack...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Baral inside?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I don't know what power Baral has, but I doubt it's enough to cause this.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Oh, %s. Look here.
(Zephyros points to a small scorch mark on the monster's arm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...A burn?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I've heard some demons spread black mist over an area to enslave the minds of creatures from other realms. This may be something similar.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It certainly wouldn't be an ordinary demon... What's wrong, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral is standing by that huge mushroom in the distance.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Has he come to greet us alone? Wait, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If he's alone, he must have something to say. I'll hear him out. Though I doubt he'll tell us everything.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I understand. We'd better be fully prepared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Once we're ready, let's enter the swamp.
(After only a few steps, a new landscape opens up, with an atmosphere entirely unlike the canyon's.)
(The air is so damp it clings to the skin. The unwelcome figure waiting ahead approaches with an ill-fitting smile.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Whelp. You ran away a moment ago, and now you finally crawl out. Where did you hide it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you mean...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Whatever you want, you won't get your way.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: You already know, but you want to hear me say it, is that it?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Hand over the spirit stone you were carrying, and I'll spare your lives.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So you recognized it wasn't an ordinary stone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you want it for...?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: If you want to know, defeat me. Before Yankas destroys the swamp and the canyon alike.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yankas?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: One of the candidates for legion commander in the Demon Realm. As cruel as Weiss. Lux lent him to me specially, at a witch's request.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: They say he betrayed someone else to join Lux. Though if he betrayed one master, what's to stop him betraying another... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Betraying a teacher and going around doing evil? You're describing yourself, Baral. Weiss, a witch, and now Lux, lord of the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You've given up your humanity.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Whatever I do is none of your concern.
(The chains around Baral's arm uncoil and lash toward %s. He then meets %s's attack with apparent ease.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You won't get away with this, Baral.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Then I'll make a way.
(Despite his words, Baral grimaces. He attacks again and again, but seems overwhelmed by %s's newfound force.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: (That man Baral is beyond an ordinary human, too. But the way %s moves... Even more inhuman than when we fought...)
Thud.
(Struck by %s, Baral crashes into a rock and falls. He regains his stance and prepares to attack, then freezes at the tip of %s's weapon before his eyes.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Guh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now talk. What do you want here?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: (Something's wrong with that man...)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Hmph. Very well. I'm only here on a commission. The witch who hired me wants...

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: The Spirit King of Vayuna Canyon destroyed. She said his spirit stone was somewhere near the canyon and told me to find it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Why would a witch want to destroy a spirit? A witch powerful enough to hire you shouldn't need a spirit's power.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I don't know her reasons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me who hired you, Baral. And what you're getting in return.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Lux passed on the request when I visited the Demon Realm. I don't know which witch it was. As for my payment...

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Do I really need to tell you that much?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Take the demons you brought and leave, and we'll spare your life.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Well, that's awkward. I'm rather hard to kill.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?
(At Baral's words, Zephyros looks around. Dozens of hidden lizardmen reveal themselves.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I knew you were hiding something... But this is hardly enough.
(Zephyros opens his spellbook. A powerful wind rises beneath the approaching lizardmen, whirling into a vortex that sends some of them flying.)
(Seizing the opening, Baral steps into the vortex as though Zephyros's magic means nothing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral, stop!
(Baral turns and lashes out with the chains around his arm. Zephyros casts again and %s attacks, but Baral deflects both.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Not bad, considering I was only humoring you. Now you'll have to face Yankas.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: A wonderfully vicious lizardman who drinks his victims' blood. He's inside Mushroom Tree Swamp right now.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: He'll be hard at work following orders. Destroying the swamp, and then all of Vayuna Canyon.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: By then, the Spirit King will show himself. Spirits cherish lands that nurture life, after all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral!
(%s strikes with all their strength, but Baral parries with apparent ease.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Choose. Will you stop Yankas from destroying the swamp and canyon? Or chase me as I hunt the Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Either way, the Spirit King will appear before me. With every last bit of his power spent.
(Dozens, then hundreds of lizardmen pour out of nowhere and charge at %s and Zephyros.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: %s. Mage. Survive this if you can. Then see if you can make it past Yankas alive.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: If you can, that is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral!
(As the pair fight the lizardmen, Baral retreats farther and farther from Mushroom Tree Swamp.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We have to deal with these first!
(Zephyros sends blades of wind into the lizardmen. As they dodge, %s strikes.)
(When the final lizardman falls, Zephyros checks that it is down for good.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That should do it... %s...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Go after Baral, %s. The spell I put on him should still hold. Take this device, and...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You go after Baral, Zephyros. I'll deal with Yankas.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What are you saying? You'll fight every monster and demon in this swamp?
(Zephyros looks at %s's face and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Haah. You've already made up your mind. All right. I'll follow Baral and keep him from reaching Sylphid. Buy you some time. Meanwhile...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I have Iris behind me.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: No one could ask for better support. Hurry, then.
(Zephyros gives a small smile and runs toward the swamp's edge.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said Yankas was a candidate for legion commander. So compared with the commanders I've already fought...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Enough pointless thoughts. Keep moving. No opponent will be easy.
(As %s crosses the swamp, lizardmen from the Demon Realm and the swamp's own monsters attack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haah... Haah... There's no end to them.
(After defeating the last attacker, %s pauses for breath. A vast shadow falls over them.)
You wish to see the end, my esteemed opponent? In that case...
(The shadow's owner raises an arm. Power gathers in a blue radiance, lifting him skyward before he crashes down.)
KRA-BOOOM!
(The crushing blow strikes with a deafening roar, blasting the ground apart.)
A fine dodge, my esteemed opponent.
(As the swamp mist slowly clears, %s regains their footing and sees a huge, powerful figure.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That nearly hit me square on...)
So composed in the presence of an enemy commander. I must commend your bearing.
(A lizardman three or four times a human's size wears sharp, sturdy plate armor and gauntlets almost as large as his body.)
Has Baral spoken of me? Then you must have some idea who I am.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yankas...

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Indeed. I am Yankas.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: The general who will fill the legion commander's seat your exploits left vacant.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: What do you wish of me? I expect the answer is obvious, but I shall hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He acts polite, but every word drips with contempt. It reminds me of someone, though they speak differently. Who was it...? It's irritating.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Speak. Or are you perhaps stalling for time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yankas, take your troops and leave the canyon. Now.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Listen carefully. If your request aligned with my duty, I would gladly withdraw. However...
(Yankas raises an arm and licks a red stain from his gauntlet.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: It does not. I must therefore carry out my liege's commands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And what did Lux order you to do?

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Do not speak my liege's name so lightly. Ah... I believe I've allowed you to live quite long enough.
(Yankas's eyes narrow, and his enormous gauntlet slams down again.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Dodged again, you little rat...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are your true colors, demon Yankas.
(Yankas lifts his gauntlet and watches the adventurer who evaded him. His tongue flicks out as he smacks his lips.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: At last, some proper human blood. Everything I've tasted lately has been so insipid...

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Surely a human blessed by a god will taste rather different?

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Now, my esteemed opponent. Offer yourself willingly to your future legion commander!
Thud.
(%s's blow drives Yankas backward. He tries to regain his stance, but sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Guh...
(He reaches for a giant mushroom to haul himself up, but his hand slips.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Im... possible... Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You understand you can't win, Yankas?

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me what Lux ordered you to do.
(Coughing blood, Yankas stares at %s, then begins to laugh.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Heh... Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Why are you laughing?

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: You really are human... A demon would have taken my head or pierced my heart by now. Heh. Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still flapping your tongue, even now.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: I'm a lizardman. Using my tongue comes naturally. Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: ...I never thought I'd fall to a human like this.
(Yankas lies still, staring silently at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: You've defeated me. I'm dead anyway. I don't know if you can do anything about it, but I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: My liege won't spare a thought for me, I'm sure. Hahaha...

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: A gate will soon appear. I believe you already know what purpose it will serve.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A gate to the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Which kind of gate, I cannot say. Heh... Cough, cough. To dream of becoming a legion commander, when all I was meant to do was buy time...

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: If this is how it ends, perhaps betraying the Grand Duke was a mistake. Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Grand Duke? So that's whose service you betrayed...

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Any other demon would have tried to kill me for my betrayal. But he was different. Heh.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: In any case, I shall...
THUD!
(Before Yankas can finish, something enormous lands somewhere in the canyon. Yankas lets out a sharp cry.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You underestimated me, Yankas...
(A dagger, drawn so stealthily it went unnoticed, is buried deep in Yankas's neck by the adventurer's counterattack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I hadn't heard your sneer beneath that sound from the canyon, I might have died...
(A moment later, Yankas's body blackens and crumbles into ash. The breeze carries it away through Mushroom Tree Swamp.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was he under some kind of curse?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. No time to overthink it. He said a gate. It must be another gate to the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Zephyros hurries toward %s, who is catching their breath after the battle with Yankas.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyros?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyros, what happened with Baral?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There's only one main road down the canyon, and the other end is a dead end... But he vanished into thin air.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could he know a shortcut?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He knew about Sylphid and came all this way. He must have some information.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But there's a bigger problem. That's why I came back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There seem to be lizardmen left in the swamp. Let's get out first, then talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Agreed. I learned something from Yankas, too...

steps.name: The Spirit King's Illusion
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Zephyros] in 「Vayuna Canyon」, then go to [Little Bluebird].
2. Enter 「Sylphid's Rest」 and find out what is happening, then return to [Little Bluebird] in 「Vayuna Canyon」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He was buying time for a gate to appear?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They've tried to connect the Demon Realm to Freios repeatedly. But I have a bad feeling this time is different.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I tried to return to Sylphid, just in case. But a barrier had appeared, and I couldn't get through.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Nothing I did worked. My power wasn't enough. Haah... I had no choice but to come find you.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I think we were only able to enter the Spirit King's domain because you were with us.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Remember where Sylphid stopped to rest? An image of him was still there nearby. I tried speaking to it, but it didn't answer.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Probably because it wasn't his actual body.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's check Sylphid's image first, Zephyros.
(At %s's words, Zephyros nods and runs ahead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hope they're both all right...)
(A small image of Sylphid floats motionless where he had been.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're right, Zephyros. Sylphid's image isn't moving at all.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: An image like that usually acts at its owner's will. There must be a reason it's motionless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Come on, %s. Hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait. What's that in the direction Sylphid's image is facing?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Is something there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I must have imagined it. Let's hurry, Zephyros.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos! Sylphid!
(Following %s into Sylphid's resting place, Zephyros calls loudly for the others.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notos! Sylphid!

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Where did they go?
(As they look around, the little birds Sylphid called Sylphins gather and settle in one spot.)
Chirp. CHIRP!
(They hurry toward the noisy birds and find Notos collapsed among them, one hand outstretched.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos! Notos, wake up!

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Where... Oh, right. This is where Sylphid was...
(With Zephyros's support, Notos stands and looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notos, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'm all right, but I believe the Spirit King has been abducted.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So Baral was a decoy...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It happened so quickly. I couldn't do anything.
(Notos bows his head, blaming himself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Notos. Tell us what happened so we can go rescue Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Someone who appeared to be a high-ranking demon came to take him. Strangely, one of his horns was broken. I tried to stop him, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A demon with a broken horn?)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: He said it was nothing personal, then shot me with an arrow. I lost consciousness...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He doesn't seem to have intended to kill you. Thankfully, there's not a scratch on you...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Do you remember anything else?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Oh... He said Lux wanted him brought to the gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The gate...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They used Baral to lure us away, and Yankas to buy time while they abducted Sylphid...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I don't think they simply want his power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid said he governs the winds of western Freios. Could they be trying to use those winds?
(At %s's words, Notos and Zephyros look at each other in unison.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, that's it!

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Brilliant, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Bringing Freios down...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Destroying the Spirit King alone wouldn't make Freios fall. Other spirits would take over his work.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: But if the Spirit King himself ordered the lesser spirits under his influence, that would be another matter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They took Sylphid to the Demon Realm to control his mind...?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We can't know for certain until we see for ourselves.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We have to find the gate quickly. I still have the spirit stone, so it shouldn't take long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I saw something below, near Sylphid's image. We should check there.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Agreed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Notos, are you sure you're all right?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You needn't worry at all. I'm tougher than I look...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You've only gotten more boastful since I last saw you. I'm glad you're all right, but don't push yourself.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha, Zephyros. No one looks out for his big brother quite like you.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Haah... Sorry I brought this brother of mine along, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'm glad you get along.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Get along...? Enough of that. Let's find a clue.

steps.name: The Door's Memory
steps.objective:
1. Go to 「Gate of Lysithea」 from [Little Bluebird]'s location in 「Vayuna Canyon」.
2. Defeat [Andrea] in 「Gate of Lysithea」 and obtain the <Bundle of Shining Keys>. Then return to [Little Bluebird] in 「Vayuna Canyon」 and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (The three retrace their steps to Sylphid's image. It still floats motionless in the air.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sylphid left an image of himself here. Perhaps he wanted to leave a trail for us to follow...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: But I can't see anything that could be a gate.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It hasn't already disappeared, has it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There seems to be a path in the direction the image is facing.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The energy from the spirit stone is heading that way, too, %s...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wait, %s. We'll go together. Ah, already gone.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyros, that path...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That's right...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Where our family used to have picnics...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes...
(Following %s to the end of the path, Zephyros and Notos find a suspicious structure utterly out of place in the canyon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That gate couldn't look more suspicious.
(Looking up from the torches burning on either side, the adventurer meets the gaze of an ornament resembling a horned devil's head.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
