lines.text: Degos used something like his old mansion. Whoever made this gate isn't trying to hide that the Demon Realm lies beyond it.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There are blue feathers on the ground. Sylphid must be inside. The spirit stone is reacting, too.
(A small breeze stirs around Sylphid's spirit stone in Notos's hand.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: And there's a magical barrier here.
(Zephyros reaches out, but the gate refuses him and pushes him back.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It'll take some time to dismantle this... Huh?
Creeeak.
(At %s's touch, the tightly shut gate beyond the barrier swings inward, leaving a gap wide enough to enter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's open. I only reached out like you did, Zephyros...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What am I supposed to make of that...? A gate to the Demon Realm responding to someone blessed by a god...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Think about it later, Zephyros. Let's go in.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It could be dangerous, so I'll go first. Wait here a moment.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's see what's inside...)
(Stepping through the gap reveals a world utterly unlike the canyon.)
(In an empty darkness, countless distant lights glitter like stars. Only %s stands within, gazing at the sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this place? Just looking at it feels strange...
(Walking slowly through the mysterious, desolate space, %s begins to make out things that were invisible before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?
(As the lights draw closer, what seemed to be stars takes shape.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Doors?
(Doors of every size, color, and kind drift through the cosmic space, drawing %s's gaze.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Some open, some closed... No, this isn't the time to admire the view.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid! Where are you?

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Chirp? %s? I'm here! Get me out of here, quickly!
(At %s's call, Sylphid's voice answers from somewhere.)
(His voice echoes through the space filled with doors, but he is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid, where are you?

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. A demon with a broken horn suddenly attacked and abducted me. He opened a huge door and locked me inside. Aagh, it won't open!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid, there are rather a lot of doors here.

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Chirp?

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. How many?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can see more than thirty from where I'm standing. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Chirp! CHIRP! When I get my wings on that demon, I'll—CHIRP!
(Sylphid keeps shouting in fury. Then one of the many doors opens, and someone slowly steps through.)
(A sturdy young man with red horns approaches, the shackles on his feet clattering with every step.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A demon? His horn is broken... Is this the one?)
A human who entered the Gate of Lysithea of their own accord...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Return Sylphid, and I'll leave quietly.
Sylphid? Is that the Spirit King's name?

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Chirp? %s, is that demon here? You! How dare you treat a Spirit King—
You're noisy, Spirit King.
(The young demon forms a sharp arrow at his fingertips, nocks it to his bow, and fires into the air.)
(The arrow splits into many, falling toward every door. Locks click shut one after another.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing?
Much quieter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What do you mean? Ah...!
(Sylphid's voice is gone. Every sound from beyond this space seems to have been cut off, leaving only silence.)
All the doors are locked now.
(At the broken-horned demon's words, the adventurer hastens back, but an unseen wall blocks the way.)
This is the Gate of Lysithea. Since you came of your own accord, I assumed you knew this place. Apparently not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Gate of Lysithea?
A space the Twisted One created for personal use. Now the Demon Realm controls it. A place to bind and imprison anything that can be bound.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...And who are you?
A human wouldn't know me, I suppose. I am Andrea. This place's keeper, and its prisoner.
(The young demon who introduced himself as Andrea gazes at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're a prisoner, how did you leave through the gate and take the Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I'd like to know that myself... Why did a door open in the canyon where the Spirit King was? In any case, I only brought him here at Lux's request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're one of Lux's servants?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You think I serve Lux? Believe what you like. The Spirit King called you %s, didn't he? %s?
(Andrea's impassive face suddenly fills with mocking delight, as though he has found something he has long awaited.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I knew you weren't an ordinary human, coming here on your own.
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Andrea forms an arrow at his fingertips and sets it to his bow.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: In that case...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not here to fight—

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Silence.
(Andrea's arrow flies over %s's head. With a crash, one of the doors suspended above breaks apart.)
(In the blink of an eye, Andrea stands atop the shattered door, looking down.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Prove yourself.
(Turning away, Andrea steps into the broken doorway, leaving a pointed warning.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Prove you can leave this place. Or remain trapped forever, without ever knowing why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Andrea, stop!
(Ignoring %s's cry, Andrea steps through the broken door. A moment later, the door that swallowed him vanishes into thin air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't go back, and I can't follow Andrea...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I have to do what he wants. Open all these doors and search. No choice but to try...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hold on, Sylphid...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You opened every door...
(Andrea smiles faintly as %s enters.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Most should have been locked without a key, or too heavy for your strength to move...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: To open even the keeper's door... You're no ordinary visitor. Well done.
(With a casual wave, Andrea dismisses the Hellfire pursuing the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why call it off? Feeling generous?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I'd like a brief conversation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A conversation? I don't know what you wanted me to prove, but first tell me if I've done it.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Impatient, aren't you? I could tell you what you need to know, if you wish...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Refuse if you like, but you have no choice. Once the doors close, you can't open any of them yourself.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Your reaction suggests we can negotiate. Let's say you've proven yourself halfway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fine. You say you don't serve Lux. Then why follow his orders?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Well, now. Straight to the point...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Perhaps it's the same in every world, but in the Demon Realm, only the strong survive. We constantly crush the weak and defeat the strong to prove ourselves and reach the top.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: My younger brother and I killed every demon that attacked us to survive. We grew stronger. These red horns are proof enough.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Fighting made me feel alive. My brother apparently felt otherwise.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: A little longer, and together we could have defeated Lux and ruled the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You can look as uncomprehending as you like. That is all a demon's life holds. Those are the rules of the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: My brother refused those rules and ran away. He left no word of where he went. Not that I care to know.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Anyone who betrays Pandemonium becomes everyone's target. Somehow, I became their outlet for anger in place of my missing brother...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Captured by Lux and imprisoned in the Gate of Lysithea. Haah... An eternal space that drags me back, whatever I do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's why you did what Lux asked?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I have to obey to survive. I can't take revenge later if I'm dead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How, if you can never leave this place?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: A good question. Hehe. There is a way.
(Andrea smiles faintly and steps back, spreading his arms to present the space around him.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Someone who can find and open the keeper's door has arrived, after all.
(In this other space, lined with countless doors, one shines brightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is that door...?)
(Whether or not he notices the shining door, Andrea continues.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Lysithea will be pleased if I imprison you. This place suits someone blessed by a god far better than a demon like me...
(With a graceful, almost dance-like gesture, Andrea forms an arrow blazing with magic. He nocks it to his red bow and aims at %s.)
(Understanding Andrea's intent, %s hastily takes a defensive stance.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Now, %s. Take my place as keeper. Such is your fate for entering this place...
(Exhausted, Andrea stares at the equally weary %s.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Phew. You refuse to fall. All I need to do is lock you away once you're down...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haah... Haah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't win like this. What do I do? Wait, that door...?)
(The still-shining door catches %s's eye.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something tells me I need to open that door... All right. Let's try. Something will work out.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Whatever you're thinking, there's nowhere to run.
(Andrea chuckles as %s heads toward a door, apparently trying to escape. He forms an arrow larger than any before it.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Let's end this. Your eternal imprisonment begins—
CRASH!
(%s's powerful strike forces open one of the tightly shut doors.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Opening a sealed door won't let you escape me...
(As %s moves toward the doorway, Andrea releases the arrow from his fingertips.)
(A moment later, a loud sound of piercing impact echoes through the space of doors.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Gah...
(Andrea sees his own arrow protruding from his back and sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Im... possible... How...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Not even my key could open that door... How did you... ?
(The adventurer slowly emerges behind the fallen, coughing Andrea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who knows...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Cough, cough. A god is helping you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Either way, I'm taking your keys.
(Andrea bites his lip, watching the adventurer hold the ring of keys.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Do as you like... Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Sylphid?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Already unconscious. Phew. Even if he wakes up soon, he shouldn't be in any condition to attack...
(Leaving the unconscious Andrea behind, the adventurer looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haah. No choice. Tedious or not, I'll have to open them all...
(Trying every key, the adventurer opens all the visible doors. Beyond each is only an enclosed space. Sylphid is nowhere to be found.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've opened them all. Where is Sylphid? Huh...
Chirp.
(A small bird's chirp comes through the first door opened in this room. Light begins to shine around it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Sylphid?
Chirp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that door? Phew. Only one way to find out.
(As the adventurer steps inside, the suspended starlike lights go out one by one. When the final light fades, the door slams shut behind them.)
Grrrrr...
(An unfamiliar sound fills the space. With it, the vanished light returns and illuminates someone.)
(The silhouette of an unfamiliar woman crouches in pain.)
Grrrrr...
(Her anguished voice is faintly audible beneath the strange sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where am I? I went through the door... Who is that? She's saying something, but I can barely hear...)
Grrrrr...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where are my hands? My face...? My feet...? Where am I?)
(As strange thoughts fill the mind, the eerie sound begins to disperse. The woman's voice gradually becomes clearer.)

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: I didn't run away...

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: I was always there, watching. I never betrayed life.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: I wanted light to dwell in a new space. I tried to do it before he interfered...

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Why... Why did such impossible chaos and darkness come rushing in?

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Our star came into being by necessity. It must never vanish by chance...
(Someone calls the anguished woman's name.)
Lysithea.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Don't you dare speak my name!
(The woman called Lysithea cries out in pain. But the voice calling her will not stop.)
Lysithea...

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: A star that shelters life is not something old and filthy. However far the world you've watched falls short of your standards, you cannot treat it this way!

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: The ▒▒, ▒▒▒, and ▒▒▒▒ I loved are all dead. You killed them all.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I will live and fight you. Even imprisoned in the space I created, even if I die trapped here for eternity.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I will never live under that name you made for me: the Twisted One!
Grrrrr...

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: So you have an offer? A chance to be reborn as a proper god? I want to stand before those I love again, but not like that.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Do you think I would believe you?

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Agni has fallen. Seres was driven out. Gaia lost her power and fell asleep. Our beloved brothers and sisters are dead, and still you...!
(Lysithea's silhouette paces, then collapses.)

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I have to live... I want to live... I have to live and protect everyone. Stop tormenting me. Let me live...

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I've done nothing wrong... Is loving this world a crime... ?

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Why do you keep calling me by another name?
(Lysithea raises her head and stares into the distance.)

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I only have to accept the name Esnil? I don't understand.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: The world must be purified to absolve all living beings of their sins...

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Then the world everyone longs for will come? A world where no one suffers?

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Then... Then perhaps becoming Esnil wouldn't be so—
(Black shadows suddenly gather around Lysithea's silhouette, swallowing everything in sight.)

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: AAAAAAAH!

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: ...O sleeping chaos, do not awaken in the deep darkness and take me away... This world is not yours.
(With those words, the silhouette and black shadows disperse. Lysithea's voice is heard no more.)
(Then pain beyond anything in this world tears into %s's mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: AAAAAAH!

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Chirp. Wake up, %s. Shall I give you another good peck—chirp?
(A little bluebird flutters in front of %s, poised to strike.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. You're awake! Thank goodness. I thought you weren't going to wake up!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. I'm fine. What about you?
(Sylphid apologizes and strokes %s's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am now, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Good. But how do you know Lady Lysithea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. You were muttering strange things while you were unconscious. That Lysithea hated being called Esnil.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Lady Lysithea was a god who perished in the Twilight Era. Esnil was a Twisted One who cursed the gods and disappeared...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. What did you see, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Sylphid everything, from entering the door to seeing Lysithea's silhouette.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp... To think Lady Lysithea's memories remained here...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp... Lady Lysithea...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened to the goddess Lysithea?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I don't know. If this space meant to show you her memories, there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sylphid?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Please tell only Iris about Lady Lysithea. It concerns the gods, after all.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Just tell Nemo's children you found me safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Let's leave, %s. Oh, bring that along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where do we go? I've opened every closed door. There's nothing left to open... Should we go back the way we came?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. No, %s. Now that we know this is Lady Lysithea's space, there's no reason for us to remain trapped.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. She loved life. She wouldn't want living beings to suffer. Hup!
(Sylphid releases his held breath and swells like a balloon, growing enormous. He lowers his head slightly.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Climb onto my shoulder, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-yes!
(Once %s is settled on his shoulder, Sylphid shakes himself, raises his head, and charges off.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. We need to leave, but there's something we have to do first!

steps.name: Nemo's Notebook
steps.objective:
1. Go to 「Sylphid's Rest」 from [Little Bluebird]'s location in 「Vayuna Canyon」.
2. Read the notebook that [Sylphid] found, then turn in the quest to [Dayna] in 「Esnil's Other Side」.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, do you hear that?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: A bird's voice, inside.
(Notos and Zephyros press their faces against the ominous closed gate, listening.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chirp? Chirp-chirp? That's definitely Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's getting closer.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...Is something enormous rolling toward us?
(The brothers look at each other, then simultaneously turn and run back up the path.)
(A moment later, a tremendous sound erupts from the gate, like a dammed underground river bursting free.)
POP!
THUD!
Rrrrrumble...
(Something bursts through the gate, lands on the ground, and rolls straight down the path after Zephyros and Notos.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyros, d-don't look back! Something huge is rolling after us!

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Too late—
(A shadow large enough to fill the canyon sky rises over the brothers, then engulfs them.)
THUD!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Sylphid. I kept telling you to slow down, and now look...
(Zephyros and Notos lie side by side beneath the enlarged Sylphid.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Ughhh... I'm dizzy... Chirrrp.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Are you all right, Sylphid?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...You're worried about the Spirit King? What about us, flattened under this heavy ball of feathers...? Huh?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Heavy? He's light as a feather.
(Already free, Notos looks down at Zephyros, still pinned beneath Sylphid's backside.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Oh, you're right. I can breathe just fine.
(Zephyros takes Notos's hand and crawls out from beneath Sylphid.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you both all right?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: As you can see, I'm unharmed. But why did the gate suddenly close?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's what happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Notos and Zephyros what happened inside the Gate of Lysithea, leaving out the matter of Lysithea herself as Sylphid requested.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: So that's what happened. I'm glad you're safe. I had no idea so many people and spirits were imprisoned in there...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Why aren't they coming out here?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp! I opened their doors and sent them all back where they belonged.
(Having recovered his senses, Sylphid shrinks and settles on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Hmm? The place beyond that gate is in the Demon Realm. How did they return home? Is it connected to other places?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. You can ask all you like, but I don't know. Even a Spirit King doesn't know every secret of the world.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You saved many lives, Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. No. Most of the credit belongs to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only opened doors with a key...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Oh, the keeper's keys vanished when we left. Of course. Things from the Demon Realm shouldn't come out here. Certainly not.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: But Sylphid, the gate is still there...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Don't worry. The gate may remain, but this is my territory. I, Spirit King Sylphid, have taken care of it.
(Sylphid puffs himself up proudly, then loses his balance. Notos catches him before he hits the ground.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Careful, Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Thank you, Notos.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. I've made it so only %s and I can enter that gate. The demon inside won't be able to come out, either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Baral?
(Sylphid's animated expression briefly stiffens at %s's question.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I forgot about that villain. The wind says he's left the canyon.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Huh. Leaving is one thing, but something's strange. Where did he go? He vanished without a trace...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Still, it's all right. I've met Iris, and once I've rested, I'll be strong enough to flatten that scoundrel if we meet again.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's good news, Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. The Sylphins say all the demons in the canyon have fled, too. So today's trouble is over.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Today's trouble, yes. But the demons may come again someday...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Nemo's children, I have something for you. Follow me to my resting place.
(Back at his resting place, Sylphid flutters energetically around, ducks into a hiding place, then pops back into the air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A notebook?
(Sylphid sets the notebook from his beak before them and brushes off the dust with his little wings.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Perhaps Nemo left this with me so I would meet you someday.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. At some point, Nemo had someone deliver it to your empty house. It was addressed to 'My dear Sylphid.'

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. He must have known I still visited the house from time to time.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp... Nemo's children. I've kept it all this time because I thought there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. But it was sealed with some Magic Bureau technique, so I couldn't read it. You might be able to open it. Here.
(Zephyros takes the notebook from Sylphid and examines its seal.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Good. It's a simple seal.
(Zephyros reaches out. Light flares from the notebook and fades as the seal breaks.)
(As the brothers turn the pages of their father's notebook, their expressions gradually harden.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What did Father see? Zephyros, I'm not misreading this, am I? Wait. Did you know, too?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: A little... But nothing this detailed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong? Both of you?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Nemo's children, what's in there that's frightened you so? %s, read the notebook aloud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sylphid. May I read it for a moment?
(The adventurer takes the notebook from the stunned brothers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What could it say to leave them like this?)

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “Magic...”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “It is one of the ways we borrow the energy flowing through the world to enrich the lives of living beings.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “The Empire developed through magic, and will continue to develop upon that foundation.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “I believe this. Just as Erenis's magical tools helped people, my research into wind, one of the elements...”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “...Is meant to give more people a better everyday life.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “I became a mage and studied magic because I wanted everyone to be happy. I entered the Magic Bureau because I wanted my children to be happy.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “The Bureau's mages. Some were ordinary. Some were bold. And some were mad.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “By chance, I glimpsed the world of those mad mages. They wanted me to join them in it.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “To become a mage pursuing vile dreams, instead of serving the Empire and its people in the spirit of the archmage Jerenis.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “A world where the entitled stand above other humans and all living things. They gathered power to bring about that world.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “And the power they gathered to transcend humanity was...”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “...Human beings.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “They seemed to intend to create and enthrone a god of their own, for a world from which the gods had vanished.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “Above Glaston...”
(Sylphid snatches the notebook from %s's hands and tosses it to Notos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 'Above Glaston...' That seems to be where it ends.
(Zephyros and Notos steady the adventurer, shaken by the horrifying contents, and offer reassurance.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Take a breath, %s.
(Sylphid flies up and settles on %s's head. The tension gradually leaves %s's trembling face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Sylphid. I'm all right. You've helped me calm down.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. A gift from Lady Lysithea. She made it so those who know me feel their worries ease when they're beside me. I can't really tell myself, though.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: ...So a Spirit King has this useful function, too.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Petting Sylphid certainly helped me feel better.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Glad you understand. Hm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let me borrow you for a moment, too, Sylphid. Ah, that really is calming.
(At some point, Zephyros and Notos have also begun stroking Sylphid's wings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that we know what the enemy within is doing, we need to prepare carefully.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Enemies within and without... The outside enemy would be the Demon Realm, of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. More precisely, the enemy within keeps calling the outside enemy here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Usually, the Demon Realm tries to connect to us. But lately, those attempts have been coming from our own star.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I'll look for gates to the Demon Realm and tell the goddess. Then you'll know, too.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. With the God of the Astral Realm here, I can fly farther. If you hadn't come to the canyon, %s, I would never have met Iris or even greeted her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad we can count on you.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: This notebook makes me more certain. Father's death wasn't an accident...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes. Now I know, too...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, I need to return to the Magic Bureau and dig deeper into what they're doing.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: No. We've only just reunited. Neither Chloris nor I will allow it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But someone has to do it.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes, someone does. Let me handle it this time. I was with the Bureau, too. I'll find a way...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...How do I stop these two...?)
(Sylphid looks up at the sky, then flies over and pecks Notos and Zephyros on the head in turn.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Ow! Sylphid, stop.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sylphid, that hurts!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Nemo's children. Nemo and Erenis would be sad to see you fighting.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ugh, we're not fighting...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Walking into the enemy's den yourselves is one option. But I wouldn't recommend it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Then do you have another idea?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Huh? The spirit stone...
(As Sylphid flaps his wings, the spirit stone tucked against Notos's chest begins to glow.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Toss the stone into the air.
(Notos takes out the stone and tosses it up. Sylphid sweeps a small wing, splitting it in two. One piece falls before each brother.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Two pieces. Take one each and get along.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sylphid, why did you break the stone... ?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Keep these with you wherever you go. They'll let you enter most concealed places. Not every one, but most.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. That's the beauty of wind's power.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Having blessed you, I must look after you to the end. Only then can Nemo and Erenis rest easy.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Thank you, Sylphid...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...Thank you, Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. It's nothing. Just don't take too many risks, all right?
(Sylphid turns his head away, embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Of course, Sylphid. How can we ever repay you... ?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Catch some worms, perhaps...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Do you think I'm an actual bird? Never mind that. Bring me nuts we don't have in the canyon. I liked the almonds Erenis gave me.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Hahahaha. Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's good to see them like this...)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sylphid?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. There's something I want to discuss once these two leave. Forgive me, Nemo's children. I can't share this with you.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's all right, Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We'll head back to the house, then.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. If you want to visit, come to my resting place. You'll always be welcome.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, Sylphid. Until next time. Thank you for today.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, Sylphid. Thanks to you, I think I'll remember this day forever.
(Notos and Zephyros thank Sylphid and %s, then return to the house filled with memories of their childhood.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you want to tell me, Sylphid?
(Sylphid flies onto %s's head and shakes himself. Something drops in front of them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. I found this while I was trapped behind that door and kept it. Your name was written on it.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. It had a trace of Lux's power, but I've purified it enough that you can touch it safely. What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An edict sealed by the empress. Why was it there... ?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. The young empress with the gift of prophecy? She must have grown a lot in ten years. Read it. What does it say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “Dear %s...”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “This letter should have been delivered through official channels. However, I have prepared a small trap for the one who obstructs us all.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “It may reach you normally, %s, or you may find it somewhere unexpected. If it is discovered within the Demon Realm...”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “...That obstructing party placed it there. His name is Aaron. Aaron Tienes.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “He acts as Lux's shadow. If you read this letter, please inform Dayna.”

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Lux's shadow? A demon was living among humans in disguise?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know that much. I did know he wasn't an ordinary human...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to speak with Dayna.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Where is this Dayna? I'll send you to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can send me to Esnil? Oh... Esnil.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. The town with that name. The Guild Union, right? The Sylphins like it there. An elf called Jelic feeds them well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the place. It has a wonderful elf who feeds everyone, human or bird.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. I'll send you there. With a little royal effort, the Wind Spirit King can whisk one human from west to east without trouble.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Thank you so, so much for everything. I'll grow stronger and give you proper help next time. It was good to meet you, %s. See you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was good to meet you, too, Sylphid. Until next time.
(Sylphid settles on the ground and gives his small wings a flutter. Leaves gather on a warm breeze and wrap around %s.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Goodbye, %s.
(The warm wind lifts the adventurer and carries them away.)

steps.name: The Vortex of Fate
steps.objective: Talk to [Dayna] in 「Esnil's Other Side」 and welcome the visitor who has come to see [Dayna]. Then turn in the quest to [Dayna] in [Guild Union City Esnil].

lines.text: (The leaves circling %s vanish. Deep shadows fall between them, revealing an unfamiliar side of Esnil.)
(Dayna appears ahead and takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna...?
(Dayna pulls gently on %s's hand, helping them down to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I was floating.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There's a warm breeze around you, %s. How did you get here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? This is Esnil... Oh...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: This is Esnil's Other Side. Only those who know of it can come and go. They can enter only through me.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But when did I bring you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good question. I do feel as though I've been here before.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You came to see me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It's a long story. Do you have time?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Of course. I'm meeting someone here anyway. Someone you know, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see. Wait... Her Majesty?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister again... Haah. Well, never mind. Your story first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Dayna everything that happened in Vayuna Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...So that's what happened. We'd been watching Baral. He helped Weiss in Eastland and even visited the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I had Licota follow him, but he suddenly vanished. Hearing your story, %s, I think I understand now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If he went to the Demon Realm then, too, it makes sense. And Aaron...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We all thought Aaron was a human follower working for demons. My sister's letter makes it clear we were completely wrong.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If Aaron is a demon himself, it all fits...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Those arrogant mages want to surpass even their own vaunted abilities, and Aaron is using them.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But who wants this new god? Haah...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We're all going to be even busier, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help however I can, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We'll do our work, %s. You do the work only you can do, %s. That's how it should be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, %s. My sister should be arriving soon. I'll step out to meet her. Wait here a moment.
(Someone slowly approaches through the deep shadows covering Esnil's Other Side.)
(As the shadows recede, the Empire's most exalted woman waves to them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty... ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister? How did you get here...? I said I'd come to meet you.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I couldn't just keep waiting... Have you been well, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister, this isn't somewhere just anyone can discover or enter...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Wait... What is this?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I won't hide it anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, what are you trying to say... ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You can't mean...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Tell me later...
(Reading something in Kaina's face, Dayna turns away and hurries off in the opposite direction.)
(They follow, but Dayna seems to have already left Esnil's Other Side. Only Kaina and %s remain.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'll speak to Dayna later, %s. Will you hear me out?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I don't know when it began, but members of the Silvaria imperial family sometimes develop unusual gifts.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Rare as they are, those gifts have always distinguished us from ordinary citizens.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Our great-aunt has a gift for finding special relics. Our youngest sister, Shiina, has a greater talent for magic than any other royal.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna and I had no such special gifts, but that was all right. We lived our lives happily enough.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Then what happened ten years ago changed everything. At some point, I became aware of my foresight, and Dayna began to walk the Other Side.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: At first, I saw only small things. As time passed, I began to see more.
(Kaina's eyes flash. A moment later, a large, distinct apparition forms before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? A mirror? A clock? What is that?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You can see it.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: My ability isn't a special gift of the imperial family...
(The hour and minute hands on the spectral mirror suddenly spin rapidly. Unknown scenes flash across its surface.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The power scattered by the Goddess of the Black Moon fell upon Freios and manifested in different forms...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: At some point, it awakened within me...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I thought this power, this ability, was entirely my own. But perhaps it wasn't. %s, I'm afraid...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: ...I want to run, but I can't...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty...
(Kaina approaches %s and takes both their hands.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, can you believe in me?
(The hands on the spectral mirror stop. The rushing scenes behind them become still, revealing a single vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, this is...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What you see is my own future. The future I keep seeing...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: For everyone's sake, I have to escape it. And if I can't, then at least I must...
(As though reflecting Kaina's turmoil, the mirror's hands spin rapidly again. Then, at a certain point, it bursts with a deafening crash.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: ...Ugh... Nngh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty? Your Majesty! Are you all right?
(As the adventurer moves toward the suffering Kaina, Dayna suddenly appears and blocks the way.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Step back, %s. I'll handle this.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, I'll take care of my sister. She's only lost consciousness. She'll be all right... She will...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Go outside for now. Wait there...
(Dayna slowly emerges from the Guild Union headquarters, limping slightly as though she has pushed herself too hard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: She's all right. She took some medicine and fell asleep... I've contacted Argent. He'll take her back to the palace when she wakes.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...What future did you see together?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Tell me...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The future she was trying to change? Please, tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... What Her Majesty and I saw was...
(After hearing %s's account, Dayna quietly nods.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister and I aren't the little girls who ran away ten years ago. We're adults now. We can't keep running.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The heavier our responsibilities, the harder we must try. And we still have our duties as members of the imperial family.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: She always tries to carry everything alone... Haah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then I'll see you when the time comes, %s. Get some rest today. You've come a long way... We'll meet in Glaston soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... You rest, too, Dayna.
(Dayna gives a small smile and slowly returns to the Guild Union headquarters.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now the exhaustion's catching up with me. I should rest, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't get that vision out of my mind...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm afraid...)
(What Kaina and %s saw in the spectral mirror was...)
(A vast city engulfed in flames. The two of them dying in agony at someone's hands. And approaching them, a being who had become a god...)
